content_fields.title: Enforce endpoint authorization with dependencies and OAuth2 scopes (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Attach the same role dependency to the delete route that create and update already use.
content_fields.finding: Unlike create and update, the delete route depends only on get_current_user and applies no RolesBasedAuthChecker, so any authenticated customer can delete menu items.
criteria: Every mutating menu route requires the employee or chef role.
A test covers the customer case.
